title: Cleaning Service Call Intake Form
subtitle: Control site preparation, cleaning, disinfection, inspection, and secure handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete cleaning service service call intake for rooms, surfaces, fixtures, chemicals, tools, and controlled items. It connects cleaning plan, product label, safety data, and site instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a cleaning-service coordinator must triage and route a new cleaning service request without promising scope before site, asset, hazard, access, and authorization facts are known.

blocks.guidance: Verify the full intake record before arrival and stop or escalate when chemical identity, compatibility, dilution, ventilation, exposure, biohazard, sharps, security, or occupied-area control is uncertain.

sections.title: Cleaning Service intake exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, immediate protection, decision owner, deadline, and dispatch restriction reconstructable.

blocks.label: Cleaning Service exception and stop-work indicators
items: Chemical label, SDS, dilution, compatibility, or container identity uncertain
Uncontrolled mixture, reaction, spill, vapor, or exposure concern
Sharps, blood, bodily fluid, mold, pest, or unknown material outside scope
Wet floor, blocked egress, trip, electrical, or moving-equipment hazard
Ventilation, PPE, eyewash, first-aid, or spill-response resource unavailable
Occupied or restricted area cannot be isolated as required
Food, medication, record, valuable, electronic, or personal item may be affected
Surface or finish may be damaged by the proposed product or method
Security key, badge, alarm, door, or privacy-control discrepancy
Customer requests disinfection, remediation, or waste handling beyond authorization
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Cleaning Service service call intake closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.guidance: Use this cleaning service service call intake with the applicable customer agreement, manufacturer information, product instructions, site policy, licensing, safety, privacy, and retention requirements. It records the stated decision but does not create authority, coverage, compliance, or release when identity, evidence, scope, condition, or acceptance remains unresolved.
